Course/ Training Evaluation Form-
Section 11.2- TACM

Evaluation of Training Courses should be regularly done between an interval of 18-24 months.
The evaluation can be done for internal courses done by the company as well as external bespoke
company specific courses or trainings.

This evaluation can be done online or whilst physically attending the training/ course.

The evaluation should be done by a person/s who do not have any conflict of interest.
